summary: @servicetitan/html-sketchapp preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: This package publishes under the @servicetitan npm scope but its package.json author/repository/homepage/bugs all point to the unrelated upstream brainly/html-sketchapp — a legitimate MIT HTML-to-Sketch converter that ships no preinstall script, no setup.mjs, and no math_init.js. This tarball adds a scripts.preinstall entry (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, checks whether the Bun runtime is on PATH and, if not, downloads a Bun release zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp path, chmod +x's it, and invokes it (via execFileSync) against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle with heavy string-array-shuffle obfuscation (rotator function, large mixed numeric/string constant table, hex-mangled identifiers), unrelated by filename to the package's advertised HTML-to-Sketch purpose and not referenced from the declared `main` entry (build/html2asketch/index). The obfuscated payload is executed via a freshly-installed alternate runtime at install time under a trojanized fork of a legitimate upstream project — the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, with attacker-controlled code running on every installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
